---
applyTo: "**/*.php"
---

# PHP Instructions

- Follow the project's PHP version and framework conventions.
- For CodeIgniter projects, follow the existing controller/model/service structure.
- Keep business logic out of views.
- Validate and sanitize external input.
- Use parameterized database queries.
- Never hardcode credentials or secrets.
- Preserve existing authentication and authorization behavior.
- Prefer small, testable changes.
- Follow existing error handling and response conventions.
